name: ruling-14-key-past-an-extent-reads-else
reference: spec 0.20, A switch on a decoded value; rulings 9 and 14; ruling 14: the extent is 0 bytes, x's line lies past it and x is absent: else, z. Ruling 9: c1 holds the sentinel, else; the else's c1 line reads 1 and does not reselect case 1. Re-encode writes every line of the extent (ruling 7 of 0.8): x zero bits, length 1, else; c1 = 1 now selects case 1, c2 absent
